data.title: 矢来美羽 · 夜间泳池的绯绒波影
data.description: 入夜后的度假酒店露天泳池亮起幽蓝水底灯，池面荡漾着碎银般的月色。矢来美羽把遮阳伞收在池畔躺椅旁，双臂搭在清凉的石质池沿上，半身浸在微漾池水里回头望来。沾水的酒红丝绒连身泳装泛着深邃光泽，夜色让她的笑意更添几分迷人蛊惑。
data.location: 亮着幽蓝水底灯的月夜露天泳池池沿
data.action: 半身入水双臂搭于池边石沿，沾水发丝垂肩回眸浅笑
data.lighting: 幽蓝水底灯漫射光与月色冷辉在湿润肌肤上折射波纹
data.camera: 微俯中景，水底冷蓝反光与酒红丝绒形成迷人对比
data.mood: 迷离、优雅、夜色下的亲密诱惑
data.promptProse: Resting her forearms along the cool stone rim of an outdoor resort pool illuminated by glowing blue underwater lights, Miu looks back over her damp shoulder. Wet blood-wine velvet and black crisscross cords gleam beneath moonlight and shimmering water caustics.
data.animaCaption: Resting her arms on the edge of the illuminated night pool, she looks back with wet hair and shimmering water ripples.
data.nsfwProse: Pool water beads across her bare shoulders and collarbone while blue underwater light traces the velvet contours.
